label: early-episode GO step with a strong a2 preference
explanation: Update-gate unit that fires almost only in the first ~20 trials of an episode (98% of mass in trials 0-19, none after trial 40), and mostly at GO (87% of mass) when the policy strongly favors a2 (choice logit < -4.4; 99.7% of activations are on trials where a2 is chosen). The rest (13%) is at D1 when a reward is shown after a2 runs. It never fires at D2 or when a1 is chosen or preferred. It fires much more in episodes that start with S2 good (95% of mass). Magnitude is largest at the first rewarded D1/GO after a run of a2 choices and then decays over the next a2 trials. Recorded predicate uses only observed quantities (the policy logit and the trial index), not future variables. Precision is about 0.5: many early a2-preferring GO steps stay silent, so the predicate misses some unknown extra dependence on history.
